facts.fact: The Niger national nutrition information platform PNIN says it officially launched its renovated web portal on 18 September 2025, with access to reports, search tools and a download space, demonstrated by the national statistics institute INS.
The World Bank says the national Open Data Portal, with some of its data, is accessible on the Niger national statistics office website.
